name: 3max-ultrix-4.5
description: Ultrix/RISC 4.5 on a DECstation 5000/200, running its own PROM

files.notes: KN02-AA system ROM of the 5000/200, with the self-tests gxemul fails patched out
Option ROM of the built-in SCSI controller (PMAZ-AA), slot 5
Option ROM of the built-in Ethernet interface (PMAD-AA), slot 6
Option ROM of a PMAGB-BA frame buffer; not in machine.json yet, as the emulated slot 0 card is a PMAG-BA
Ultrix/RISC 4.5 install CD (a raw UFS image, not ISO 9660)
Root disk with Ultrix installed: start install.json, boot 5/rz4/vmunix at the >> prompt, and install
